note: lap 12 pre-check (no model call): laps/lap-11/rules.json with the lap 12 candidates, minUi in place of minService and ui in place of service. Per request: the rules it states (one behaviour a scenario can check), the pairs of rules the request text ties together (one rule's sentence uses the other's outcome), each with the reason, and (lap 12) the ui rules: rules that can be checked only on the page, either what the page shows (an error text, an order, a count, a format) or how a page action works (what a click changes, what a step keeps). Counted by the author for the calibration requests (lap 9's strict versions, as in lap 10 / 11) and the candidates alike. A candidate passes when its pair count is at least pairsTimes x the largest calibration count (34, as in lap 10 / 11), its words (whitespace-separated, as wc -w) are within words (lap 10 / 11's candidate range), and it has at least minUi ui rules. Rules: laps/lap-12/runbook.md.
